text:
emma: kicking off RC for v2.7.1 to address reranker scoring regression. target promo tonight in the 01:00-02:30 UTC change window. artifact: ghcr.io/redwood/release:v2.7.1-rc1-20260325. please sign off quick.
rory: on it. i'll run the short perf smoke and a db migration dry-run in staging.
priya: can we pin the model runtime to runtime:1.9-quant to avoid the new float32 path?
emma: yes, pin runtime=1.9-quant. update promo note and CI tag.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] RC validated: SBOM OK, vuln scan low severity only, image-size 134MB. Suggested canary: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m holds. Command: `/deploy plan rc v2.7.1-rc1 --canary 1,5,25 --holds 10m --metrics latency95=350ms,error_rate=0.5%`
nate: quick QA on staging: smoke-ok, integration-e2e small flake on search-rerank (investigating). logs attached: ```grep ERROR /var/log/search/rerank.log | tail -n 5```
priya: infra note: rolling-lock acquired for region-eu-west-1. no overlap with infra maints.
rory: perf on staging: p95=180ms, error_rate=0.03%. db dry-run migration reports 0 row locks but warns about index rebuild time ~3m. not blocking.
emma: ok final checklist before we create promo: 1) runtime pin set (priya) 2) smoke e2e green or acknowledged flakes (nate) 3) deploy plan ready 4) rollback triggers defined 5) oncall assigned.
priya: rollback rules proposed: auto-rollback if error_rate increases >0.5% absolute or p95 >350ms sustained 5m. manual rollback if customer errors reported.
emma: oncall will be rory. rory OK?
rory: i got it. i'll be on the pager.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promo plan created: promo-id rc-v271-1798765430. Use `/deploy promote rc v2.7.1-rc1 --promo-id rc-v271-1798765430 --quietwindow 01:00-02:30UTC` to kick off.
release-bot: [release-bot] Changelog entry draft created: "v2.7.1-rc1: mitigate reranker score drift; pin runtime 1.9-quant; performance fixes." Edit at https://wiki/release-notes/v2.7.1
nate: investigating the flake: looks like a timing-sensitive test caused by mock clock. not present on prod-like load. not blocking for promo.
rory: starting canary now (1%). will watch dashboards.
infra-bot: [infra-bot] Canary 1% deployed to region-us-west-2. healthchecks OK.
release-bot: [release-bot] Canary check @1%: latency95=192ms, error_rate=0.02%.
rory: advancing to 5%.
infra-bot: [infra-bot] 5% deployed. brief spike noticed on host i-0a123, infra alerted.
ate: spike looks like a brief GC pause on i-0a123, nothing widespread.
priya: mark i-0a123 as suspect and drain if it shows repeat behaviour.
rory: holding at 25% until we validate 5% stability.
release-bot: [release-bot] 5% check: p95=205ms, error_rate=0.04%. no DB lock increases.
rory: moving to 25% now.
release-bot: [release-bot] 25% check: p95=230ms, error_rate=0.06%. still within thresholds. observed one host GC tail but median unaffected.
priya: infra running a quick kernel tuning on the suspect host, should be transparent.
rory: ok pushing to 100%. initiating final promote.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion to 100% started. Promo-id rc-v271-1798765430.
release-bot: [release-bot] Post-promo healthcheck: latency95=238ms, error_rate=0.08%, traffic healthy.
emma: great. i'll publish release notes and update the changelog with the final blurb: "v2.7.1: fixes reranker score regression; runtime pinned to 1.9-quant; canary rollout encountered transient GC on one host resolved during rollout."
rory: added rollback snippet to runbook: `/ops rollback rc v2.7.1 --reason p95>350ms or error_delta>0.5%`
nate: filing a follow-up ticket to track GC tail on i-0a123: TICKET-1228.
emma: thanks all. I'll close the RC ticket and leave a short postmortem note if TICKET-1228 shows repeat issues. :tada:
